slot.intent: The film is called The Wirecard Collapse: its name, framed, at the largest size the package uses.

concept: The film's name, read into its frame: whole at the largest size in quiet grey, each word settles to off white as it is read, two hairlines open to its width, and a red highlighter writes the last.
storyboard: 0.2 s, on "The": the whole name fades up in a quiet grey at the package's largest size; The settles to off white as two grey hairlines start opening from the centre above and below it
1.4 s, on "Wirecard": Wirecard settles to off white in its place, nothing moving, and the hairlines open on at a steady pace
2.7 s, on "Collapse": a red highlighter wipes along Collapse, turning it off white on red as it passes, while the hairlines slow into the name's width
3.3 s: at rest, the name framed by the two hairlines, its last word on the red bar, held for reading; the card fades it out
In 9:16 the name stands on three lines at a size it can hold within the safe area. The camera never moves.
